title: CISA Flags Multiple PaperCut NG/MF Flaws Exploited in the Wild
content_md: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added two critical vulnerabilities related to PaperCut NG/MF to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, warning that these flaws are being actively exploited. The vulnerabilities, identified as CVE-2026-81578 and CVE-2026-82078, can be combined to enable unauthenticated attackers to modify server configurations and execute arbitrary Java bytecode […] The post CISA Flags Multiple PaperCut NG/MF Flaws Exploited in the Wild appeared first on GBHackers Security | #1 Globally Trusted Cyber Security News Platform .
